original_ai_prompt: Build a small lab network where nothing uses DHCP. Every PC should have a fixed address I set, because this is a test bench and the addresses must never change. Six PCs, all on one network, all static.
cleaned_prompt: Build a small lab network where nothing uses DHCP. Every PC should have a fixed address I set, because this is a test bench and the addresses must never change. Six PCs, all on one network, all static.

requirements.statement: All six PCs reach each other
Every host is statically addressed, no DHCP

expected_behaviour: Single VLAN, dhcp=False, all groups addressing='static'. No internet.
capability_limitations: Single VLAN, dhcp=False, all groups addressing='static'. No internet.
why_suitable: Clean static-addressing case; tests dhcp=False + per-group static, the opposite of the DHCP-heavy norm.
